title: Let Grafana Assistant build your first dashboard
body: Stuck staring at a blank dashboard? Click the [Grafana Assistant](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/machine-learning/grafana-assistant/) icon (top-right) and describe what you want to see in plain English. It writes the [PromQL](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/datasources/prometheus/query-editor/) or [LogQL](https://grafana.com/docs/loki/latest/query/) and lays out the panels for you.

title: Drilldowns beat raw queries when you're exploring
body: Before writing PromQL, try [Metrics Drilldown](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/visualizations/simplified-exploration/metrics/) under **Explore > Metrics**. Point-and-click to filter labels and break down by dimension. Same idea works for [Logs](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/visualizations/simplified-exploration/logs/), [Traces](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/visualizations/simplified-exploration/traces/), and [Profiles](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/visualizations/simplified-exploration/profiles/).

title: Logs Drilldown reads logs without LogQL
body: [Logs Drilldown](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/visualizations/simplified-exploration/logs/) auto-extracts fields and shows you [volume, patterns, and errors](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/visualizations/simplified-exploration/logs/investigate-logs/) visually. Great for the 'I just want to see what's in there' moment, no [LogQL](https://grafana.com/docs/loki/latest/query/) required.

title: Use $__rate_interval for rate() queries
body: Hardcoding `rate(metric[5m])` breaks at long time ranges. Use [`rate(metric[$__rate_interval])`](https://grafana.com/blog/2020/09/28/new-in-grafana-7.2-__rate_interval-for-prometheus-rate-queries-that-just-work/) and Grafana picks a window that matches your [scrape interval](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/datasources/prometheus/template-variables/) and panel view automatically.

title: Integrations beat hand-rolled Alloy configs
body: [Connections > Add new connection](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/connect-externally-hosted/) has [prebuilt integrations](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/monitor-infrastructure/integrations/) for hundreds of systems with dashboards and alerts included. Install one before writing [Alloy](https://grafana.com/docs/alloy/latest/) config by hand.

title: Adaptive Metrics cuts your bill without losing signal
body: [Adaptive Metrics](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/cost-management-and-billing/reduce-costs/metrics-costs/control-metrics-usage-via-adaptive-metrics/) aggregates high-cardinality series you aren't querying. Most stacks see 20-50% cost reduction with zero dashboard changes. Find it under [Cost Management](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/cost-management-and-billing/).

title: Annotate deploys to correlate spikes with releases
body: Add an [annotation query](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/dashboards/build-dashboards/annotate-visualizations/) for your CI deploy events. Vertical lines appear on every panel showing exactly when something shipped. Pairs well with [Knowledge Graph](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observability-as-code/knowledge-graph/) for automatic correlation.

title: Service accounts, not API keys
body: [API keys](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/administration/api-keys/) are legacy. Use [service accounts](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/administration/service-accounts/) (**Administration > Service accounts**) with scoped permissions and rotatable [tokens](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/administration/service-accounts/#add-a-token-to-a-service-account-in-grafana). Required for new Cloud features going forward.

title: Variables make one dashboard work for every environment
body: Add a [`$env` variable](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/dashboards/variables/) (**Settings > Variables**) instead of cloning dashboards per environment. Use it in queries like `up{env="$env"}`. Combine with [multi-value and 'All'](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/dashboards/variables/variable-selection-options/) options for the full effect.

title: Alerting: contact points are reusable, notification policies route
body: Define a [contact point](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/alerting/configure-notifications/manage-contact-points/) (Slack, PagerDuty, email) once. Then build [notification policies](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/alerting/configure-notifications/create-notification-policy/) that match labels and route alerts to the right team. Don't create a new contact point per alert.
